ranking_note: editorial priority, not measured consulting fees

topics.title: Should we buy this, build it, or change the process?
topics.decision: Choose the smallest justified investment for a specific business outcome, including ownership and ongoing maintenance.
topics.why: McKinsey reports that 32% of respondents' organizations declined at least one software purchase because they could build internally with agentic coding tools; 37% report some enterprise EBIT impact from AI. This makes investment selection timely, without proving that building is cheaper.
topics.first_episode: Compare an existing product, a small custom solution, and the current process for one fictional employee request. Save the assumptions, option comparison, success measure, and human decision.

sources.title: McKinsey: The state of AI in 2026
sources.note: Published August 25, 2026; fielded May 4-June 8, 2026. Online survey: 1,719 respondents in 97 countries; 36% work at organizations above $1 billion annual revenue. Results are GDP-weighted and self-reported. Purchasing choices do not establish comparative costs, realized returns, or consulting fees.

topics.title: Can this employee see this answer?
topics.decision: Define authoritative sources, role-based access, and the person responsible for resolving conflicting evidence.
topics.why: Salesforce/MuleSoft reports that 49% identify cross-application data governance as a top integration challenge. Flexera reports security and compliance as the leading cloud-AI challenge for 53%. These findings support access discovery; they do not measure chatbot leak rates.
topics.first_episode: Give two synthetic employee roles access to different documents. Demonstrate permitted and denied retrieval, then retain the source register, access matrix, and repeatable checks.

sources.title: Salesforce/MuleSoft: 2026 Connectivity Benchmark Report
sources.note: Published February 5, 2026; fielded October-November 2025. Survey of 1,050 managerial-or-higher IT leaders across nine markets at organizations with at least 1,000 employees. Vendor-sponsored, self-reported enterprise findings; not representative of all businesses.

sources.title: Flexera: 2026 State of the Cloud Report
sources.note: Released March 18, 2026; independent-panel survey of 753 technical professionals and executives worldwide, fielded in winter 2025. Includes smaller and enterprise organizations. Vendor-sponsored respondent perceptions, not measured security incidents.

topics.title: Where should the human take over?
topics.decision: Specify the boundary between answering, proposing an action, and executing it, with a named human decision owner.
topics.why: Salesforce/MuleSoft reports only 27% of applications integrated together and 50% of agents operating in silos. Microsoft finds 50% of surveyed AI users identify output quality control as an increasingly important human skill. Workflow and approval design are useful priorities inferred from these findings.
topics.first_episode: Follow one fictional request from question to proposed action. Show a person reviewing evidence at the chosen handoff. Save the workflow map, approval rule, integration contract, and exception route.

sources.title: Salesforce/MuleSoft: 2026 Connectivity Benchmark Report
sources.note: February 5, 2026; 1,050 IT leaders at enterprises with 1,000+ employees, nine markets; October-November 2025 fieldwork. Vendor-sponsored self-reports; integration percentages are not causal estimates of business value.

sources.title: Microsoft: 2026 Work Trend Index
sources.note: Published May 5, 2026; 20,000 AI-using knowledge workers across ten markets, surveyed February-April 2026. Nonusers were excluded. Skill ratings are self-reported, not measured competence. Microsoft telemetry is a separate, platform-specific dataset. The page's methodology and chart notes differ on the April fieldwork end date.

topics.title: What does one successful AI task actually cost?
topics.decision: Set an acceptable cost per successful task together with quality, latency, review effort, and workload assumptions.
topics.why: Flexera reports managing cloud spend as a challenge for 85% of respondents and estimated wasted cloud spend of 29%. These findings justify cost visibility; they are not guaranteed savings for a particular business.
topics.first_episode: Measure a synthetic task including retries, infrastructure, and review effort. Compare two configurations against the same success check. Save the cost worksheet, assumptions, quality threshold, and monitoring plan.

sources.title: Flexera: Cloud value and waste findings, 2026
sources.note: March 18, 2026 announcement of the 753-person global survey, fielded winter 2025. Vendor-sponsored respondent estimates; waste is not an audit or a recoverable-savings guarantee. Survey findings do not establish that AI caused increased waste.

topics.title: Do we replace the old system or connect to it?
topics.decision: Choose whether to retain, expose an interface to, or replace one capability after tracing its business rules and dependencies.
topics.why: Ensono reports that 71% experienced modernization budget overruns within the prior 24 months and 61% paused, reduced, or abandoned initiatives. This supports careful scope discovery, not a universal recommendation to retain legacy systems.
topics.first_episode: Trace one dependency in a fictional legacy workflow. Compare three modernization options and select one reversible first step. Save the dependency map, decision, phased plan, and rollback condition.

sources.title: Ensono: The 2026 IT Modernization Reality Check
sources.note: 2026 report; survey fielded June 2026. Publication day is not displayed on the reviewed page. Sample: 500 IT decision-makers and business leaders, equally divided between the US and UK, at organizations above $500 million revenue. Vendor-sponsored self-reports; geographic and company-size limits apply.
